name: Free ICC online Drop-In Workshop (EN)
description:
Have fun and meet new people in a supportive online environment - for free!

The ICC is now offering a free 2 hours drop-in class open to all levels of improv experience.

If you want to donate for the drop-in feel free to do so here: http://www.improvcomedy.eu/product/donate-to-save-icc/

The 2 hours will offer a combination of 2 to 3-person scene work as well as group exercises that fits the online medium.
All our teachers have completed online training and are ready to provide you with a fun improv experience online!

Time: 17:30-19:30
Streaming Location: You will receive a link to the streaming channel in your order confirmation.
Teacher: Thomas Søby Andersen
Language: English

GET MORE INFO & SIGN UP HERE:
http://www.improvcomedy.eu/product/online-drop-in-workshop-🇬🇧-18-05/

Please note:
- The minimum age for all ICC classes is 18.
- Classes start on time and if you are more than 30 minutes late without letting us know, you may not be able to join the class, as you will have missed warm-ups. This is at the teacher’s discretion.
